summary: Accomack County, VA tower listed by the FFLA as standing; no build, owner, staffing, access or history found in the sources read.

facts.status_note: Listed as standing on the FFLA Virginia list, which gives no date; no later confirmation found

evidence.supports: Accomack County tower listed as standing at the stated coordinates
Forest Lookouts index places the tower in Accomack County
NHLR Virginia page counts 48 registered lookouts; its name table, checked in full, has no Hallwood entry
evidence.quote: There are 48 lookouts registered in Virginia.

notes_for_editor: Only the FFLA directory line and the Forest Lookouts county index support this record. Not on the NHLR Virginia list. The brief's county, status and coordinates match the FFLA list. A search snippet claimed a VDOF owner, a 2008 status date and a 2011 database update, but I could not open a page showing those fields, so none is recorded; verify before publishing any ownership or date claim. Wording of the status is an undated listing and should not be read as an inspection.
